facts.function: network security: one-way data transfer (data diode), keyboard/multi-computer switching, data transfer software
facts.form: group of separate network security products (hardware appliances and software)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8517 covers machines for reception, conversion and transmission or regeneration of data in a network
Chapter 84 note 6(D)(ii): apparatus for communication in a network is excluded from heading 8471 when presented separately
GRI 6: 8517.62.00 then statistical line 'Other' since not a modem nor a switching/routing apparatus

rejected_alternatives.reason: chapter 84 note 6(D)(ii) excludes network communication apparatus from 8471; rulings seen (G85043) were older ethernet switch rulings
data diode is not a switching or routing apparatus
keyboard/multi-computer switches are not simple electrical switches for circuits; they function as data switching units

missing_facts: classify separately: keyboard switch, multiple computer switch (could be 8471.80 or 8536), software on media (8523)
whether the goods are entered as one set
classification.rationale: The first-named article, a data diode, transfers data between networks and regenerates/transmits it, placing it in heading 8517.62 as other data communication apparatus. Rulings seen for ethernet switches (G85043) were not relied on since they predate the current note structure and concern different products.
